name: Crystal cave
one_line: Slate-blue rock lit by teal and violet crystals.
look_words: A cave lit by its own crystals. Slate-blue rock in big faceted planes, darker in the distance, with still black pools that mirror the light. Clusters of large angular crystals in teal and pink-violet give a cool, quiet glow that reaches a little way up the walls and no further. The crystals are what the player is here for, so teal and violet are the reward colours; orange-red marks harm, and the player carries a warm cream lamp that stands apart from all the cool light. Shapes are angular and simple. Motion is small: slow glints moving across facets, drips, ripples, drifting dust in the lamp beam. Avoid rainbow colours, glow on everything, thick fog, bloom and pure black where the player walks.

palette.name: crystal cave
palette.notes: There is no sky in a cave: the sky colours are the dark roof. The weak cool "sun" stands in for the general glow; add small coloured lights at the crystals.

look_wish: faceted flat shading with soft drawn glows, or none
